---
- name: Step 003 Pre Software
  hosts: localhost
  connection: local
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Print the inventory groups
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "groups={{ groups.keys() | list }}"

- name: Configure the bastion
  hosts: bastions
  become: true
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Read the generated lab SSH key
      ansible.builtin.slurp:
        src: /home/lab-user/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub
      register: lab_key

    - name: Publish the bastion SSH key as a fact
      ansible.builtin.set_fact:
        bastion_ssh_key: "{{ lab_key.content | b64decode | trim }}"

- name: Hand the bastion key to the simulator nodes
  hosts: localhost
  connection: local
  gather_facts: false
  tasks:
    - name: Write the key into the lab user secret
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: "/tmp/{{ guid }}/lab-user.pub"
        content: "{{ hostvars[groups['bastion'][0]].bastion_ssh_key }}"
